snippet.title: 🖌️Paint your city in City Painter! | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🖌️Play City Painter in Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4361900/City_Painter
Advanced city simulator with minimalist "Paint" graphics. Build complex intersections, edit traffic rules, and solve traffic jams without melting your PC.
